blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five current neutral renders and six poses shows thin angular lavender trim projections at the front-left, side, and rear hem joins. V104 confirms that the selected panel edges were joined through canonical sewn IDs (6 transitions per overskirt panel in the build audit), but the rendered corners remain visibly pointed; continuous curve connectivity alone did not resolve the corner silhouette.

The right-side and rear views retain repeated waist-to-hem ridges and localized folds after the V104 bending-stiffness increase from 10 to 20, with the V103 panel mesh, pins, gravity, and fairing held constant. The rendered surface remains visibly uneven and below appearance acceptance.

Crouch and sit still show lifted/folded overskirt panels and exposed under-shorts; prone remains visually distorted. Avatar fit, final rig weights and shape-key coverage, Unity/VRChat runtime, and package eligibility remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
